'''Malignant Force''' is a [[mod]] that increases both the {{D|Toxin}} damage and [[status chance]] of a rifle by 15% per rank for a maximum of 60% at rank 3.

==Stats==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Mod#Mod Rank|Rank]]
! {{D|Toxin}} Damage
! [[Status chance]]
! [[Mod#Attributes|Cost]]
|-
| 0 || +15% || +15% || 4
|-
| 1 || +30% || +30% || 5
|-
| 2 || +45% || +45% || 6
|-
| 3 || +60% || +60% || 7
|}

==Acquisition==
* Originally acquired as a limited-edition reward from participating in [[The Cicero Crisis]] (50 points)
* Can be acquired as a possible drop by killing [[Corrupted Vor]] in [[Orokin Void]] missions level ≥40 such as [[Mithra]] and [[Mot]]
** 25% drop chance; it has 100% drop, but shares this with its counterparts - [[Pistol Pestilence]], [[Virulent Scourge]], [[Toxic Barrage]]
* It was also acquired as a drop from [[Razorback|Razorback Armada]] via killing the Razorback; however, this is no longer possible.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*'''Malignant Force''' is additive with similar mods. For example, a {{Weapon|Snipetron}} with a max rank '''Malignant Force''' and {{M|Rifle Aptitude}} will have a {{Math|20% {{mul}} (1 + 60% + 90%)|t = y|p = y}} status chance.
*This mod can be combined with {{M|High Voltage}}, {{M|Thermite Rounds}} and {{M|Rime Rounds}} to achieve a combined status chance bonus of 240%. With {{M|Rifle Aptitude}} and {{M|Hammer Shot}}, this bonus can be increased to 410%, more than quintupling the weapon's status chance.

==Patch History==

{{ver|11.5}}
*Introduced along with [[The Cicero Crisis]].

{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|The Mk1-Paris is the standard issue bow for all Tenno.}} The '''Mk1-Paris''' is the [[Mk1]] variant of the {{Weapon|Paris}} and is the standard issue bow for new [[Tenno]] recruits. This weapon is best for new players who desire a stealthy approach to ranged attacks. This weapon can be sold for {{cc|2,500}}. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage. {{Advantages|}} {{Disadvantages|}} {{WeaponComparison|Paris}} {{WeaponComparison|Paris Prime|header=n}} ==Acquisition== Mk1-Paris can be purchased from the [[Market]] for {{cc|15,000}}. ==Notes== *The MK-1 Paris is a slightly weaker version of the standard {{Weapon|Paris}}, with less overall damage. It handles identically otherwise. However, it has a very minuscule 0.1 second faster reload. *Enemies will notice missed arrows but arrows that hit are silent. ==Incarnon Genesis== {{Transclude|Paris Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}} {{Transclude|Paris Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}} ==Tips== *Charging can be cancelled without releasing the arrow using the reload button (Press reload button while holding the left mouse). *All "charge weapons" (except {{Weapon|Angstrum}}) are now capable of holding their charge during a [[Maneuvers#Sprinting|sprint]], and as long as the user starts the charge, they are able to finish charging while they are still sprinting. This allows for more mobility to the user such as charging their weapon in cover, then run into the room and to unleash their first shot at first sight at the enemy immediately. **Using elevators and opening co-op doors also does not cancel the charge, however hacking consoles and opening lockers will. **[[Maneuvers#Sliding|Sliding]] when you are about to hit the ground (from any height) is very useful for keeping your charge instead of losing it by [[Maneuvers#Rolling|rolling]]. *Use a [[Squad Ammo Restore]] instead of the {{M|Arrow Mutation}} to gain more mod capacity, while maintaining large pools of ammunition. Or bring along Carrier equipped with [[Ammo Case]]. ==Trivia== *The Mk1-Paris was introduced as one of three starter Primary weapons in {{ver|14}}, alongside the {{Weapon|Mk1-Braton}} and the {{Weapon|Mk1-Strun}}. *Unlike other Mk1 weapons, the Mk1-Paris has a different appearance compared to the default counterpart, featuring slightly different colors and textures. *Paris is most likely named for Paris of Troy in Homer's Iliad, who was a skilled archer and the one to have killed Achilles by firing an arrow into his heel. *The Paris is the only bow that does not have a tension spring, as the arrow is held in place and launched by magnetic induction rather than physical force. ==Bugs== *After charging an arrow and firing it while zooming, the next arrow you fire will not be drawn from the quiver, and instead the Paris and your hand will jerk very slightly. The next shot will show the reloading animation correctly. *On Xbox One, entering a mission by dropping from the Liset shows the arrow stuck to the Tenno's hand. The same can sometimes be seen when extracting. **Both bugs are visual only and do not affect the gameplay. ==Media== ParisBowCodex.png|Mk1-Paris in Codex MK1-Paris 1.png|Mk1-Paris when equipped in the arsenal MK1-Paris 2.png| {{VideoGallery}} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|34}} '''Mk1 Weapons'''
Along the lines of Flawed Mods, the less powerful Mk1 variants of the Braton, Paris, Kunai, and Bo have been removed from the Vor’s Prize Quest. Now, new players will be presented with the normal variants of these weapons. '''Rest assured that all Mk1 weapons still remain available for purchase with Credits in the Market!''' {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *MK-1 Paris {{ver|25.7}} *Normalized quick shots to have the same critical chance/damage and status chance as charged shots. *While reviewing Bow stats the team has also refreshed all their FX (including the Lenz)! *Quick Shot increased from 100 to 115 *Charged Shot increased from 120 to 230 {{ver|19.10}} *Paris model reworked. {{ver|14.2.3}} *Introduced }} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Paris}}, the normal counterpart. *{{Weapon|Paris Prime}}, the [[prime]]d counterpart. *[[Paris Incarnon Genesis]], the Incarnon power-up for the Paris series. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:MK1-Paris]] [[es:MK1-Paris]] [[fr:MK1-Paris]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Bow]] [[Category:Mk1]] [[Category:Tenno]] [[Category:Update 14]] [[Category:Silent]] [[Category:Single-Shot]] [[Category:Puncture Damage Weapons]] [[uk:Паріс-MK1]] [[Category:Weapons Purchasable For Credits]]

{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|The Strun is a standard issue shotgun for all Tenno. Reliable, versatile and deadly.}} The '''Mk1-Strun''' is the [[Mk1]] variant of the {{Weapon|Strun}} and is standard issue shotgun for new [[Tenno]] recruits. Although its damage is quite low, it has decent status potential. It can also be sold for {{cc|2,500}}. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage. *Innate [[multishot]] of 10 pellets. *Reloads one shell at a time at a rate of 0.5 seconds per shell, which can be interrupted at any point, allowing for planned reloading. **Reloading has a 0.5 second delay to start and a 0.25 second delay to end. **Individual shell reload causes magazine increasing effects to increase total reload speed. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun| *High overall [[status chance]]. *Good [[Ammo#Ammo Efficiency|ammo efficiency]]. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun| *Tied with {{Weapon|Cedo}} for the second lowest base damage of all pellet shotguns, after {{Weapon|Boar}}. *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% from 15m to 25m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Tied with {{Weapon|Strun}} for the second slowest reload speed of all shotguns, after {{Weapon|Strun Wraith}}. }} {{WeaponComparison|Strun}} {{WeaponComparison|Strun Wraith|header=n}} {{WeaponComparison|Strun Prime|header=n}} ==Acquisition== A built Mk1-Strun can be purchased from the [[Market]] for {{cc|15,000}}. ==Notes== *Reload time is 0.75s + 0.5s per round, coming to 3.75 total seconds to reload a completely empty mag. **This time will further increase if magazine mods such as {{M|Ammo Stock}} are used. *The Mk-1 Strun is a slightly weaker version of the standard Strun, with less overall damage and a slightly slower rate of fire. ==Incarnon Genesis== {{Transclude|Strun Incarnon Genesis#Acquisition}} {{Transclude|Strun Incarnon Genesis#Incarnon Genesis}} ==Tips== *Using the {{M|Shotgun Ammo Mutation}} mod can help regain ammo when needed, although not as often as the full auto shotguns. *Weapon's spread cone can be shrunk by zooming in. ==Trivia== *The Strun appears to use a tubular magazine, presumably the cylindrical protrusion near the rear above the stock - the Warframe will push this section while reloading. **Assuming the Warframe is adding shells into this tube, or replacing it, it would imply that the shells used by Strun are extremely small, which is quite puzzling given the enormous size of the barrel diffuser. *The regular Grineer [[Trooper]] used to use this weapon prior to {{ver|11}}. They now wield a {{Weapon|Sobek}}. *The Strun is most likely a Tenno weapon, despite its augmentation the {{Weapon|Strun Wraith}}, a Grineer-focused customization. The Strun bears a faint Tenno marking on its stock as proof. **Additionally, the Strun shares many similarities to the {{Weapon|Boar}}, which is a weapon that has received a [[Boar Prime|Prime]] version, proving it as Orokin technology. ==Media== MK1-Strun 1.png|Mk1-Strun as shown in the Arsenal MK1-Strun 2.png {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Mk1-Strun {{ver|27.2}} ;Greater than 100% Status having meaning: Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case. Shotguns as a special case means we have buffed the Status Chance of all Shotguns by x3 or greater. The UI now behaves to show the reality that you are determining Status Chance per pellet. *(Undocumented) Status chance per projectile increased from 2% to 6%. {{ver|17}}
Several changes have been made to shotgun weapons across the board -- resulting in a list of changes similar from weapon to weapon. The following list of changes apply to all Primary Shotguns with exception to the Phage: *Increased damage across all shotguns. *Damage after projectile falloff has been increased for all shotguns. *Some shotguns have been given improvements to reload speed. *Some shotguns have received improvements to their projectile speed. *Death at close to mid range will now toss enemies into a forceful ragdoll. *(Undocumented) Strun series changed from magazine-based reload to shell-by-shell reload. {{ver|14.2.3}} *Introduced }} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Strun}} the normal counterpart of this Weapon. *{{Weapon|Strun Prime}}, the [[Prime]] variant of this Weapon. *{{Weapon|Strun Wraith}}, the [[Wraith]] counterpart of this Weapon. *[[Mk1]], the special prefix of the Weapon. *[[Strun Incarnon Genesis]], the Incarnon power-up for the Strun series. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:MK1-Strun]] [[es:MK1-Strun]] [[fr:MK1-Strun]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Shotgun]] [[Category:Mk1]] [[Category:Tenno]] [[Category:Impact Damage Weapons]] [[uk:Стран-MK1]] [[Category:Weapons Purchasable For Credits]]

{{Top|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.}} The '''Mara Detron''' is a [[Void Trader]]-exclusive variant of the {{Weapon|Detron}} that has altered stats along with a unique animated skin. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals {{D|Radiation}} damage. *Can use the {{Weapon|Detron}}-exclusive {{M|Thermagnetic Shells}} mod. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun Sidearm| *Very high overall [[status chance]]. *Good [[accuracy]]. *Innate [[multishot]] of 7 pellets. *Fast [[Projectile Speed]]. *Very ammo efficient. *Medium spread. }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun Sidearm| *Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 37.5% from 16m to 30m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). *Projectiles have travel time. }} {{WeaponComparison|Detron}} {{WeaponComparison|Tenet Detron}} ==Acquisition== *The Mara Detron can be purchased from [[Baro Ki'Teer]] in the Concourse section of the [[Tenno]] [[Relay]] for {{cc|200,000}} and {{dc|500}}. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance. *Like [[Weapon Augments#Syndicate Weapons|Syndicate Weapons]], unranked Mara Detrons without [[Forma]] and [[Orokin Catalyst]]s can be traded between players. ==Tips== *The Mara Detron's increased fire rate means that mods like {{M|Lethal Torrent}} make it fire faster than can be clicked manually. Turning on the fire manual trigger weapons continuously setting can alleviate this. *The Mara Detron is a secondary shotgun so Multishot mods {{M|Lethal Torrent}} and {{M|Barrel Diffusion}} will increase the pellet count. *As the Mara Detron is essentially an improved {{Weapon|Detron}}, refer to the [[Detron#Tips|Detron's Tips]] for more upgrade/optimization possibilities. ==Trivia== *The Mara Detron can be visually identified from the standard Detron by the diffuse cloud textured animation on its body. **This animated texture is based off the weapon's energy color, and thus can be changed to match any hue the user wishes for. **As with the [[Syndicate|Syndicate reward weapons]], when the Mara Detron is stolen by a [[Drahk Master]] it will appear as a regular {{Weapon|Detron}} on the ground and will revert to its Mara variant when picked up. *The Mara Detron has a distinct sound when fired, closer to traditional shotguns than the energy-based weapons regularly used by the Corpus. *Despite being from the Orokin Era, it does not appear to be manufactured by the [[Orokin]]. As a smuggler's weapon, it may be implied this weapon was designed outside of their authority. It might similarly be speculated this could be a clue to the very early origins of the [[Corpus]]. **This is reinforced by [[Parvos Granum]]'s origin. Being the founder of the Corpus, and known to live during the time of the Orokin while being accompanied by an officially-assigned [[Protea|Warframe]]. He mentions that the Corpus board of directors sabotaged his ship, sending him to the Granum Void long ago. Likely meaning the Corpus were already well-established in the Origin System during Orokin rule. *The Mara Detron ejects its magazine when reloading. **Oddly, however, it reverts to its default colors (black with orange lights) when ejected, rather than any applied custom colors. *The flowing effect on the weapon is similar to the flowing effect on Steam's [[Phased Skins]] promotional items, as well as the [[Prisma]] weapons that [[Baro Ki'Teer/Current PC Items|Baro]] also occasionally sells, only reddish-orange instead of sea-green or bluish-cyan, respectively. **This may possibly imply that the weapon uses Prisma crystals in its construction, or a similar material, given its similarities to a Prisma weapon. *The Mara Detron was leaked as an entry in a player's Profile under ''Equipment'', along with the {{Weapon|Imperator Vandal}}, before it was revealed to be sold by the Void Trader Baro Ki'Teer. *Mara is a Hebrew female adjective, meaning ''bitter''. **It is also a word in the in-universe language of [[Voidtongue]], introduced long after this weapon. *This is currently the first and only Mara-type weapon. Despite this, however, both the statistic and visual enhancements are extremely similar to a Prisma weapon. *On [[Baro Ki'Teer|Baro]]'s 50th visit, this item could be purchased at half price for {{cc|100,000}} and {{dc|250}}. {{SkinGallery}} ==Media== MaraDetronCodex2.png|Mara Detron in the Codex {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|m9X3qEUNF2I|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|e5hqzXvK-xU|size=300px}} }} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|41.0.3}} *Fixed the Mara Detron being listed as a Primary weapon in Baro Ki'Teer's wares. {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Secondary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 20 Ammo per Pick Up: *Mara Detron {{ver|27.4}} *Cleaned up FX to improve performance with the Mara Detron, and tweaked their projectile lifetime to 3-5 seconds. {{ver|27.2}} ;Greater than 100% Status having meaning: Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case. Shotguns as a special case means we have buffed the Status Chance of all Shotguns by x3 or greater. The UI now behaves to show the reality that you are determining Status Chance per pellet. *(Undocumented) Status chance per projectile increased from {{#expr: 32/7}}% to {{#expr: 32/7 * 3}}%. {{ver|25.7}} *Fixed the FX on the edge of the War fading out very quickly if the Mara Detron is equipped. {{ver|25.0.4}} *Fixed Mara Detron projectile firing incorrectly when in Glaive+Gun mode. {{ver|22.13.1}} *Fixed numerous projectile weapons (Detron, etc) having incorrect Status Chance calculations. {{ver|22.12}} *Damage increased from 30 to 40 (per pellet). *Status chance increased from 20% to 32%. *Critical chance increased from 5% to 8%. *Fire rate decreased. {{ver|21}} *Damage increased from 20 to 30. *Damage fall off added starting from 16m and ending at 32 with a minimum damage of 15. *Status Chance increased from 10% to 20%. *Critical chance increased from 2.5% to 5%. *Increased Accuracy for hip and aimed fire. *Mastery Rank 9 required. {{ver|19.8.1}} *Fixed the Detron Mara having the name switched as Mara Detron. {{ver|18.0}} *Detron series now available for use in Conclave. {{ver|15.6.3}} *Introduced to Baro Ki'Teer's rotating stock. }}{{ver/Lu|23.6.2}} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Detron}}, the normal counterpart of this weapon. *{{Weapon|Tenet Detron}}, the [[Tenet]] counterpart of this weapon. *[[Baro Ki'Teer]], the vendor who can sell the weapon. {{VoidTraderNav}} {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Mara Detron]] [[es:Detron Mara]] [[fr:Detron Mara]] [[ru:Мара Детрон]] [[Category:Corpus]] [[Category:Single Sidearm]] [[Category:Radiation Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Secondary Weapons]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Update 15]] [[Category:Baro Ki'Teer Offering]] [[Category:Special Weapons]] [[uk:Детрон-мара]]
